label: Gear Trader
note: IP-neutral. Market stall: the legal shop (the fence is the other side of the market: contraband, bounties, his armour). Pays buy_rate x item value for gear, tools and weapons and sells what it holds at sell_rate x value (or its 'prices'), so anything sold to it can be bought back. 'endless_stock': what it always has and never runs out of: jetpacks, grenades, the plasma welder (20 cr, for anyone who sold or never got T-89's), the rifle (400 cr, the one way to buy one; a story save can also steal the barracks' spare), the sniper rifle (600 cr) and the seeker launcher (900 cr). Its menu (GearController, 'sections'): first Buy or Sell. Buy lists the 'sections' goods under their headings: what you do not have yet is 'Buy a <name>'; what you have is 'Upgrade your <name>' (a page of its upgrades, when it has any; 'fixed': the pistol, always yours) and 'Buy an extra <name>' ('many': a stack like grenades, 'Buy a grenade' with the count you carry). Anything else it holds (bought from you) is listed after them. 'offers': the one-time upgrades (src/systems/items/gear_upgrades.gd: factors on paths in the target's data); 'name' is how its upgrade page lists it. The ranch villages' stands use this same file; the station's booth is station_gear_trader.json.
